description.text:
The first Expansion Sheet series, the blue one, released on 23 March 1998: 36 cards on eighteen numbered sheets of three, sold with cardboard damage counters and coins.

Japan's Expansion Sheets, which collectors call the Vending Series, were sold from vending machines as random sheets of glossy cards to peel off. Each series is split into six places in Kanto, and every numbered sheet always holds the same cards, which match its place. Blue's six places run from Professor Oak's Laboratory and Viridian Forest to Celadon City. Three of its cards, Poliwrath, Snorlax and Mr. Mime, carry art from a CoroCoro Comic illustration contest (the fourth contest card, Mewtwo, is on the green sheet), and some of the cards later came out in English as Wizards Black Star Promos through the 2001-2002 Pokémon League.
